title: The Joke
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens The Joke and the helm marks Plywood Fort. Do: Close on Plywood Fort. It is painted as a patrol fort. The guns are real. An interceptor shoots first. Finish: come inside Plywood Fort's shell. Black Sail heat rises. The fort is still plywood. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
